question: What was the main focus of India's Sixth Five-Year Plan (1980-1985)?

options.text: Poverty alleviation and modernization of technology

solution:
The correct answer is __**Poverty alleviation and modernization of technology**__.
 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**
 
• The **Sixth Five-Year Plan (1980-1985)** of India aimed at achieving a balance between growth and social justice. Its primary focus was on **poverty alleviation** through employment generation and modernization of industries. 
• It introduced programs like the **Integrated Rural Development Programme (IRDP)** and **National Rural Employment Programme (NREP)**, which were key strategies for reducing poverty by providing employment opportunities in rural areas.
